subject: Scaffold project: package.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, .env.example
description:
Create the project scaffolding files exactly as specified in the plan:
- `package.json` with name "haystack", type "module", dependencies (@google/genai), devDependencies (typescript, vitest, tsx, eslint, @types/node), scripts (build, dev, test, test:run, lint, example), bin (haystack-generate), engines (node >=20)
- `tsconfig.json` with target ES2022, module NodeNext, strict true, rootDir "src", outDir "dist"
- `vitest.config.ts` (basic config for the test runner)
- `.env.example` with documented env vars (GOOGLE_API_KEY, HAYSTACK_OUTPUT_DIR, HAYSTACK_MODEL, HAYSTACK_ASPECT_RATIO, HAYSTACK_SEED, HAYSTACK_MAX_OUTPUTS)
- Run `npm install` to generate lock file and install deps

Do NOT create src/ files yet.
